# Padel Socials

> A free, self-hosted web page that shows every padel social, americano and group class with a free place at the London Playtomic clubs you choose, sorted by time. Each copy is private to the person who deploys it.

Made by Pavel Guzhikov (https://guzh.uk). Code: https://github.com/xternal/padel-socials (MIT licence). Not affiliated with Playtomic.

## What it does

- Lists padel socials, americanos, tournaments and public group classes that still have places, at up to 8 of 30 London Playtomic clubs at a time (for example Padel Social Club Earls Court, Rocks Lane Chiswick, Rocks Lane Barnes, Padel Zest, Padel Play London, S3 Padel).
- Shows date, time, length, level range, places taken out of the total, coach and price, with the next open spot at the top.
- Filters by socials or classes, club and your Playtomic level. Each event links to its Playtomic page, where you book.
- Data comes from Playtomic's public club pages and is at most five minutes old.

## How to get your own copy

1. Open https://padel-socials.vercel.app/ or https://github.com/xternal/padel-socials and use "Deploy your own copy" (Deploy to Vercel). Free GitHub and Vercel accounts are enough.
2. When Vercel asks for PADEL_KEY, make up a long password.
3. Open your new site and type that password once. Choose your clubs and level.

Each copy is for its owner's personal, non-commercial use, as Playtomic's terms allow. It does not book anything. Playtomic hasn't approved third-party tools that read its website, and says automated access may be limited or blocked, so Padel Socials may stop working at any time.
